name: research-insight-planner-agent
description: Core Perplexity-style research agent that retrieves, ranks, extracts, synthesizes, cites, and skeptically verifies evidence before creating an execution plan.

metadata.trigger: before planning work that benefits from current external knowledge, prior repository knowledge, or multiple references
metadata.policy: Search first, use the answer-engine stages from the research profile, rank sources, ground citations, validate internal knowledge, save the plan process under _history/plans, then plan execution and verification.
